commitResults.messageBody:

Member editing and restoration rely on lookups preserving identity, and
collection replacement relies on resolved members having stored indices.
These internal assumptions are not expressed as Java assertions.

Assert lookup identity and stored-position invariants before mutation.

exercise assertion failures without changing live data.

and wrap the member edit constructor declaration. Limit functional-code
changes to 47 added and 12 deleted lines, including comments and blanks.

commitResults.messageBody:
The member JSON adapter names its boolean field deleted, which does not

property so existing files and saved output stay compatible. Add a
round-trip regression test for both deletion states and property names.

commitResults.messageBody:

commitResults.messageTitle: Restore the Help window after the minimize settles
commitResults.messageBody:
The minimized-window test iconified the stage and called focus() in
one FX action. On Linux, GTK reports the minimize asynchronously, so
that late event re-minimized the restored window and failed Java CI
under Xvfb.

Minimize, restore and assert in separate FX actions, as happens when
a user minimizes the window before pressing F1. The assertions are
unchanged and still fail if a late event re-minimizes the window.

commitResults.messageTitle: Preserve draft return conditions across scrolling
commitResults.messageBody:
Keep each open loan's return observation in the Loans panel so row
recycling and filtering cannot silently drop it. Clear stale drafts
when loans close and keep later loans independent.

Add regression coverage for recycling, filtering, explicit omission,
reassignment, and submitting then reloading a damaged return. Update
the user guide and developer manual checks.

Fixes #389

commitResults.messageTitle: Merge current master into return-condition fix
Clarify repair step before loan reassignment
commitResults.messageBody:
The manual return-condition check leaves the equipment DAMAGED,
which correctly blocks reassignment. Mark the repaired unit GOOD
before checking that its next loan starts without an observation.

integrating the latest team fixes. The release PR now differs from
master only in the application version bump to 1.6.

commitResults.messageTitle: Simplify the equipment add activity diagram

The diagram traced method calls through the parser, transaction and
UUID supplier. That left twenty actions, five final nodes and crossing
retry loops in an image over 2,100 pixels tall, so readers could not

branch node and labelled the edges yes or no. The course notation

commit diagram did.

group header, the list card and the view feedback. Test that all
three agree when insertion and UUID order differ.
